description: Permanently delete a campaign, ad squad, ad or audience. Heavily guarded: the item must be PAUSED (audiences excepted), must have spent nothing in the last 30 days, a campaign must have no ACTIVE ad squads, and you must pass confirm_name equal to its exact name. Cannot be undone. Previews (and shows any blockers) unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

confirm_name.description: Exact name of the item, copied from the preview

name: snap_delete
